source_rule.source: first32 distinct complete saved baseline games with total_games>=15600
source_rule.exclude: no outcome-based filtering; do not substitute earlier games; retain every screened source and fail on invalid records; assert no overlap with previous evaluation and confirmation seed manifests; fail instead of silently skipping overlaps
source_rule.split: within each chronological block of4: indices0,1 update; index2 selection; index3 confirmation
source_rule.units: 16 update games,8 selection games,8 confirmation games; no seed crosses splits; mirrors/three roots are clustered by source game
source_rule.prefixes: for each nominal prefix5,13,21 use the first state at or after that prefix where the original model seat is on turn; follow only the recorded prefix; no outcome filtering

labels.policy_target: onehot root action from existing stateless fixed-clock64-sample isolated A9, proof limit1000000 each
labels.factual_target: original saved trajectory return for the original model seat, with mirror seat mapping preserved; provenance kept
labels.teacher_target: measured terminal actor return when both seats use that same diagnostic A9 from the identical actual state, including the teacher root action
labels.input: features for current player only; assert current player equals mapped original model seat at every root; legal mask/action/features round-trip
labels.null: two reused plus one fresh call at identical root/seed, all full64 samples and same legal action required
labels.randomness: decision seed = source seed XOR0x102687, plus absolute move index; use identical rule in all mirrors; save every request/reply and exact prefix
labels.interpretation: single actual hidden world and bounded diagnostic teacher, not conditional expected teacher value, teacher action-Q, or production-time A9 value; original factual targets remain unchanged

copy_trial.precondition: all192 roots complete, exact provenance/reducer/card conservation/mask/actor/score checks passed; no live state migration
copy_trial.control: teacher policy CE plus factual return MSE, coefficients1 and1
copy_trial.candidate: same teacher policy CE plus measured teacher-continuation return MSE, coefficients1 and1; candidate is an experimental teacher-distillation critic, not a replacement for current behaviour V
copy_trial.initialization: deepcopy the same frozen14786 full model and original AdamW moments into both experimental copies; no model/optimizer initialization of existing parameters; live weights and all replay/RNG/population/progress untouched
copy_trial.budget: exactly32 minibatches of64 sampled update rows with replacement, seed100526087, identical batches/order for both arms; existing saved optimizer learning rate/weight decay, clip5; one thread
copy_trial.data: update16 games only; selection8 and confirmation8 each evaluated once after the single fixed32-update endpoint; no interim endpoint, feature, rate or source selection
copy_trial.metrics: masked teacher CE/top1, teacher-return MSE and factual-return MSE on all splits, stage-wise and game-cluster summaries; frozen initial metrics also retained; no win-rate inference from these metrics
copy_trial.mechanism_gate: in selection and separately confirmation, candidate teacher-return MSE must be strictly below control overall and in all three nominal stages; teacher CE must be no higher and top1 no lower than control overall and in all stages. Report factual MSE as a distinct estimand; do not hide its worsening. Failure at selection cannot be overturned by confirmation.
copy_trial.adoption_gate: none: even a successful mechanism gate authorizes no live/source/production change. Different value estimands and teacher compute require a separately preregistered end-to-end heldout game comparison before any adoption; all current learning backups/compatibility checks remain mandatory

runtime.heavy_work: normal save-stop; both live OS locks free before acquiring both fail-closed; single nice15 process, absolute wall+monotonic1200sec per chunk and90sec per teacher call
runtime.resume: persist immutable source/split/protocol/model hashes and completed roots; on timeout save failure/partial trace, exclude incomplete root from completed counts and recompute only that root on next chunk; never change source selection based on results
runtime.preserve: full live latest.pt bytehash before/after each chunk and verification; keep all weights/AdamW/replay/RNG/population/progress/PR8/old backups; remove only own stop.flag and resume unchanged v3 after lock/hash checks
runtime.failure: null disagreement, incomplete sample count, invalid record or incompatible resume fails closed; preserve evidence and investigate without silent exclusions
